decisions: util.js exports exactly the 21 names of §6.1 (Rng, ease, clamp, lerp, lerpExp, smoothstep, round5, round10, roundDesign, hashString, fmtCoins, noise1, Pool, scratch, isIOS, isTouch, hasHaptics, vibrate, storage, mulberry32, warnOnce); check-imports confirms 21 exports. Rng seed handling: seed coerced to uint32 (non-finite → 1); fork(offset) = new Rng((seed + offset) >>> 0), so ctx.rng.fork(7) on seed 1001 gives seed 1008 as the contract implies. int(min,max) is inclusive and tolerates swapped bounds; shuffle is in-place Fisher–Yates (allocation-free); pick returns undefined for an empty array.

Pool: fixed capacity created once via factory(i) (§14 rule 3, never grows); each pooled object carries a pool-maintained `_poolIndex` field; alloc() returns null when exhausted (caller increments ctx.debug.dropped); free(obj) swap-removes and returns false for a non-live object; forEach(fn) passes (obj, index), is allocation-free and tolerates freeing the CURRENT object inside fn (re-visits the swapped-in index); clear() sets count = 0.

noise1(t) returns signed value noise in [−1, 1] (C¹ smoothstep blend of hashed lattice values, no RNG state) — chosen because its only consumers are the camera shake offsets (0.35·noise, 0.25·noise) and prop jitter, which need a signed centred signal. Consumers wanting [0,1] use 0.5·(1+noise1(t)).
roundDesign(v) compares thresholds on |v| and preserves sign (so −33 → −35), matching GDD §4.4 'round to 1 below 30, 5 between 30 and 100, 10 above'; values at exactly 100 round to 10.
fmtCoins: ≤ 999 → plain; 1 000–99 999 → one decimal + 'K' with trailing .0 dropped (1.2K, 12K); 100K–999K → integer K; ≥ 1M → 'M' with the same rule; negative values keep a leading '-'.
hashString is FNV-1a 32-bit (uint32), stable across sessions (suitable for seeding mulberry32 from ids).

storage: backing store resolved once at module load exactly per §6.1 (window.localStorage getter inside try/catch, '__t' set/remove probe, null on any throw); every get/set/remove is additionally try/catch wrapped; a Map mirror always receives writes so a failed persistent write still reads back in-session; set() returns false and flips storage.volatile = true on a quota/private-mode failure (SaveStore reads this to show the volatile caption).

All browser probes (isIOS, isTouch, hasHaptics) are evaluated once at load behind `typeof navigator/window !== 'undefined'` + try/catch; isIOS implements the iPadOS 'MacIntel + maxTouchPoints > 1' rule; isTouch uses maxTouchPoints, 'ontouchstart', then a guarded matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)'). util.js imports cleanly in node (verified) and never touches document.

risks: check-imports' comment/regex stripper is heuristic (no full JS parser): a `/` division immediately after a `)` or identifier is handled, but exotic cases (regex literal right after a `}` that closes an expression, or template literals with nested backticks inside `${}`) could mis-tokenize and in the worst case hide or fabricate one import; errors are therefore possible as false negatives in pathological code, not crashes.

A throwing frame is reported once (warnOnce with stack, error {fatal:true} event, ui.showError(msg, true) → RELOAD) and the rAF loop is stopped, instead of re-throwing every 16 ms.

Auto-scaler: refreshMs = median of the first QUALITY_TIERS.scaler.refreshSamples valid rAF intervals (hitches > 250 ms and the first frame excluded) snapped to the nearest refreshSnap value, measured in any state; the 60-sample rolling windows of interval and jsMs run ONLY while state is 'playing', quality.auto is true and time.now ≥ quality.frozenUntil (otherwise the window is reset); drop when mean interval > dropFactor·refreshMs for dropAfter s, raise when mean interval ≤ raiseFactor·refreshMs AND mean jsMs < raiseJsMs for raiseAfter s and tier < maxAutoTier; one change per hysteresis s (a manual setQuality also starts that window); _lastChangeAt starts at −Infinity so a bad level start can drop after 3 s. Positions (GDD §8.3 'rear / centre / front / above / ahead'): sniper at (squad.x, 0, squad.depth + 2·rowPitch) — its crate is assumed to be part of the model (TROOPS.sniper.crateH is a models.js key); medic at squad.slotWorld(0) + half a slot in x (falls back to squad.x/centerZ when slotWorld is absent); flamer at (squad.x, 0, −rowPitch), one row ahead of the front row; drone at (squad.x, TROOPS.drone.hover, squad.centerZ) with a softer lag rate; APC box centre at z = −(ahead + length/2) so the box spans [−2.5−3.4, −2.5] and TROOPS.apc.crushOffsetZ (−1.7) lands the crush circle on its front edge, exactly matching ARCH §7 `damageInCircle(apcX, apcZ − 1.7, 1.4, …)`. All troops follow with lerpExp (snap on jumps > 6 m, e.g. add()) and lean/bank into lateral velocity.

Sniper: timer accumulates to TROOPS.sniper.every and then HOLDS ready (fires the moment a target appears) instead of skipping a cycle. Target = zombies.highestHp; fallback boss.aimPoint (nearest living twin core; ctx.world.bossX/bossZ + BOSSES.coreY if aimPoint is missing) when ctx.world.bossActive. dmg = TROOPS.sniper.dmg·level.waveHz()·profile.damage; boss call = boss.damage(dmg·bossMult, 1, x, BOSSES.coreY, z, crit=true) so the boss shows a crit number too. Emits troop:fire {id,x,z,tx,tz} (x,z = muzzle world position: the model's child named muzzle/nozzle/barrel, else FIRE.muzzleOffset rotated by yaw) then weapon:fire {id,x,z}; the sniper yaws toward the target for 0.9 s and kicks back 0.18 m.

Medic: every TROOPS.medic.every s, only while squad.count < level.expectedSquad() and healed-this-level < capPerLevel; n = max(min, ceil(pct·C)) clamped to the remaining cap; squad.addSoldiers(n, 'medic', medicX, medicZ) (fx shows the green +n from squad:count). The cadence timer keeps running while C ≥ E (no catch-up burst). Cross glow = owned material clone pulsing emissiveIntensity between 0.6× and 1.6× base at 1 Hz plus a +3.0 flash on each heal.

Flamethrower: zombies.damageInCone(x, z, 0, −1, FLAME_HALF_RAD, range, dps·dt, 'burn') every step while zombies.alive > 0, dps = TROOPS.flamer.dps·waveHz·profile.damage. halfAngle is passed in RADIANS (coneDeg/2·DEG2RAD = 0.218) — see verifyAtIntegration. Because damageInCone returns only a kill count, the burn tag uses one zombies.forEachAlive pass (module-level callback, no closure) that calls setBurning(id, TROOPS.flamer.burnSeconds) for every alive zombie inside the cone and counts zombies within range + 3 m to drive the visual 'firing' state. Flame particles: fx.emit('flame', nozzle, 1, opts) at TROOPS.flamer.emitPerSec (30/s) while something is in reach, a 4/s pilot flame otherwise; jet speed = range / life so it reaches 7 m; colorIdx is left to fx's default for the 'flame' kind.

Drone: TROOPS.drone.rate shots/s via an accumulator (keeps at most one shot banked while there is no target); target priority zombies.nearestOfType('runner') → zombies.nearest → boss.aimPoint when bossActive (so the drone keeps firing during a boss fight with no minions). weight = dpsFraction·weapons.squadDps() / (profile.damage·weapons.damageMult) so each bullet deals 5 % of squad DPS; bullets spawn at the drone muzzle (hover − 0.3 m) with FIRE.bullet.speed/life and kind 'drone' — hit tests are XZ-only so the height is cosmetic and the tracer visibly leaves the drone. A false return from spawnBullet (pool full) drops the shot (weapons counts the drop). Drone bobs, banks/pitches with velocity, spins a rotor child, blinks its LED and dips on each shot.

APC: pool = TROOPS.apc.poolBase + poolPerLevel·L with L = ctx.level.level (floor, min 1 — endless runs without a level number use 1). apcIntersects = circle-vs-AABB in XZ. apcAbsorb consumes min(kills, pool), flinches/flares/sparks, and at 0 calls zombies.damageInCircle(x, z, explodeRadius, squadDps()·explodeDpsSeconds, 'explosion'), emits explosion {x, z, radius, kind:'apc'} and remove('troop.apc', 'destroyed') → troop:remove. Crawler crush: since damageInCircle has no type filter, the shared forEachAlive pass calls zombies.damage(id, 9999, x, crawler.height/2, z, 'crush') for crawlers inside the crush circle. Smoke rises from 60 % pool down to 0 (0→10 particles/s); wheels roll at roadSpeed/0.45 about each wheel's own local Y (rest quaternion × spin, so pre-rotated cylinder wheels keep their axle); headlights flicker and flare on a hit.

Glow parts (medic cross, drone LED, APC headlights, sniper lens) are found by name once in init() and their materials are CLONED before any emissiveIntensity write, so cached MaterialLibrary materials shared with other meshes are never mutated; the clones are restored on reset/remove and disposed in dispose().

Sibling systems (squad, zombies, weapons, boss, level, fx) are attached to ctx after troops in boot order §4.1, so they are cached on the first step() (_bindRefs) rather than in init(); every behaviour degrades to a no-op when a system is missing (stub harness per §14 definition of done).

Low-tier blob shadows: render.blobShadowSlot(RENDER.blobShadow.slots.troops + index, x, z, scale) every frame for present troops and (…, 0, 0, 0) for absent ones so a removed troop's disc disappears; render() therefore does not early-return when no troop is present.

`list` returns a live array owned by the module (rebuilt on add/remove, never per frame); callers must not mutate it. reset() emits no troop:remove events (level start is silent); remove() always does.

Verification: node --check OK; node import OK (no DOM/WebGL at import time); tools/check-imports.js reports 0 errors / 0 warnings for troops.js (imports only three, ./util.js, ./data.js); a stubbed-ctx harness (scratchpad, not in the repo) exercised init/reset×2/add×5 (+duplicates false)/600 steps/apcAbsorb to explosion/remove/reset/dispose×2 and a 200k-frame allocation bisection: every troop sits at the harness noise floor (≈2–7 bytes/frame, identical to the no-troop baseline), i.e. no measurable per-frame garbage.

zombies.forEachAlive(fn) is used in the HOT path (one pass per fixed step while the flamer or APC is present) with a module-level callback `fn(id, type, x, z, hp)`; it must be allocation-free, must tolerate zombies.damage() being called on the CURRENT element from inside fn (the APC crush kills crawlers mid-iteration), and must only visit `alive` entries. models.buildTroopMesh(key): troops passes the short key first ('sniper','medic','flamer','drone','apc'), then 'troop.<key>'. Materials of the named glow children must be per-mesh or cloneable (MeshStandardMaterial with `emissive`); troops clones them once in init(). If models.js already gives each glow part its own material the clone is merely redundant.

The medic stands inside the formation (GDD 'blob centre'); with large squads it visually overlaps soldiers despite the half-slot x offset — acceptable for the genre but worth a look once models.js lands (the cross glow is what makes it readable).

waveHz() returns the hz of the most recently spawned wave or run-up (hp[t]/ZOMBIES[t].baseHp for the first type present; 1 before the first wave); since the run-up is the last wave before the boss this equals the run-up hz during the fight (D7). run.waveHz mirrors it.

Endless: pseudo-script {id 0, name STRINGS.hud.endless, length = chunks·300, roadSpeed/eBoss of the current chunk, expected: []}; E(z) and speed come from LEVELS.endless formulas (min(600, 150·1.06^D), min(12, 9 + 0.15·D)); the difficulty switches when the squad crosses a chunk start and the next chunk is appended LEVELS.endless.bufferM (70 m) early with endless:chunk {index: D−1 (0-based), difficulty: D}; `level.level` in endless = LEVELS.endlessUnlock + D (so ZOMBIES kills2FromLevel-style rules and LEAK_BANDS scale with difficulty; ui must label by run.endless / level:start.endless, not by level number); level:progress.fraction is the progress within the current chunk (length = D·300).

Endless rubber band (GDD §10.1) is implemented in level at chunk append from the live count: C < rubber.low → first gate event of the new chunk becomes a + pair of max(lowBase, round(lowFrac·E)) with gateDefaults caps; C > highMult·E → ÷2 pair, one lane with the gateDefaults step (shootable to x2) and one with a never-reached step; frozen events are left untouched.

Endless score accrues live: run.score += roadSpeed·dt·SCORE.endless.metre·streakMult per step, + kill/gate/miniBoss·streakMult on zombie:die (cause ∉ {bite, cleanup}), gate:pass and a mini boss:dead; streakMult doubles every SCORE.endless.streakSeconds without a squad:loss and resets to 1 on a loss. endless:end and the state data carry an extra `newBest` flag (score > previous save best) so ui can show STRINGS.endless.newBest.

Stats: zombie:die counts kills only for causes other than 'bite' and 'cleanup'; hitsPerGate accumulates weighted hits per gate slot and is flushed on gate:pass or gate:miss; finalVsBase = |mult|/|base| for x/÷ and |value|/|base| otherwise; lostToRed += before − after on a −/÷ pass that shrank the squad; lostPerWave is flushed at each wave/run-up spawn and once more in finish(); debug:histogram {key, value} is emitted (when ctx.debug.enabled) for hitsPerGate, finalVsBase, lostPerWave, bossTtk and countAtBoss. Extra RunStats fields: killCoins, miniBossKills, streakMult, streakSeconds, countAtBoss, eBoss, newBest.

finish(won) campaign: stars 1/2/3 from run.survivors vs STARS.two/three·eBoss, bonus = round(ECONOMY.levelBonus(L)·(1 + ECONOMY.starBonus[stars])) via coin:pickup, score per SCORE, payout = run.coins, save.addCoins/recordLevel/setLastIncome/addStats, state.set('complete', fresh {level, stars, coins, breakdown copy, survivors, eBoss, score, endless:false}), level:complete. decisions: Rig animation lives entirely in boss.js (ARCH §6.4 lists no models.animateRig, and §6.8 says BossSystem owns the CPU-animated rig); models.animateRig is NOT called even if it exists, to avoid double animation. Parts are resolved by name once per rig at init (torso, head, jaw, armL, armR, legL, legR, core, shield; plates = meshes named /^plates?\d*$/ or the mesh children of a 'plates' group, capped at BOSSES.plates; chains = /^chains?\d*$/). Rest transforms are captured at init and re-applied by reset(); a `nested` flag (head not a direct child of the group) suppresses bob/crouch offsets on head/arms/jaw/core so torso-relative rigs are not double-moved. Limb meshes are assumed to have their origin at the joint (rotation.x swings them); the rig is assumed to face +Z at rest (yaw = atan2(squadX−x, squadZ−z)).

Rigs are built in init() for every root archetype (hulk ×2 for twins, spitterQueen, juggernaut, colossus) via models.buildBossRig(root), added hidden to the scene; if buildBossRig is missing or throws, a compact procedural fallback rig with the same named children (7 m, PALETTE.boss colours) is built so a stub harness still renders. Every MeshStandardMaterial on a rig (except core/shield) is cloned once per rig so the phase-3 rage glow and the 60 ms white hit flash write emissive on a private material, never on the MaterialLibrary cache; castShadow = true on rig meshes except core/shield.

boss:intro is emitted for mini-bosses too (duration 0, immediately followed by boss:fight) so audio can roar; ui's '(not for mini)' letterbox caveat only makes sense if the event exists. Mini skips lockInput, freezeQuality, setInvulnerable, pauseTimers and dollyTo.

Phases are 1-based in `phase`/boss:phase (1, 2, 3 — matching GDD prose and STRINGS.boss.phase); for twins boss:phase is emitted only when a twin advances past the pair's reported phase and `phase` returns the furthest twin. Transitions only move forward (shield regen never re-enters an earlier phase). Phase 2 generic beat: plates detach with sparks for every archetype EXCEPT one whose phases carry a platesOff action (juggernaut), where the detach happens with that action (phase 3) together with damageMult 1.5 applied per unit. Phase 3 generic beat: one last horde of BOSSES.lastHorde walkers once per pair, plus the archetype's own onEnter spawn.

Colossus shield semantics: `shield: 0.15` raises a hits gauge (needed = resolved shieldHits: 40 / 60 Prime); while up damage is ignored and weight accumulates (boss:shield on every change); the boss regenerates shieldRegenPerSec·maxHp per second of its OWN HP while the shield is up, with the total regen clamped to shieldPct·maxHp (the 'shield size'); the shield drops only at `needed` weighted hits; weight-0 hits (drone) make no progress. Shield mesh visibility/pulse and the bossCore light colour follow the state.

boss:hp.fraction is quantized UP to BOSSES.hpChunk (5 %) so the bar falls in chunks (GDD §7); hp/maxHp carry the exact sums. Emitted on every damage call, at HP_EMIT_HZ during regen, and once at death (0).

Attack targeting: slam ring and car x-band are centred on the formation centre (squad.x, squad.centerZ) captured at telegraph start; 'charge' stripe is centred on the formation-centre x clamped inside the road (the player must move ≥ width/2); 'lane' uses the road half (WORLD.laneCenters.pair) containing the formation centre; boss:attack.lane = 0 (left) / 1 (right) for charge/lane, −1 otherwise. Charge/lane: after the telegraph the unit lunges at roadSpeed+speed for `duration` s (never past chargeStopZ), x lerps to the stripe, the stripe test resolves at the end of the lunge, then it walks back to the hold before attacking again. Stomp is unavoidable (GDD gives no dodge rule) but telegraphed by a ring at the boss's feet. spit3 launches 3 globs (centre + ±spread, rng jitter) with flight T = max(preview, dist/ZOMBIES.spitter.spit.speed) and an 'arc' decal per glob; rain launches `splashes` globs evenly over `duration` s at ctx.rng targets in the rain box; every glob resolves independently with the §7 formation-centre test (< splash), APC absorb, squad.removeSoldiers(k,'spit') and emits spit:impact { kills = soldiers actually removed }. Spit kills = kills (+1 from kills2FromLevel, i.e. 2 from L10). 'cycle' walks the archetype's cycle[] array using arch[kind] as the param object.

Kill resolution order (_applyKills): troops.apcAbsorb(n) first when the APC intersects the attack footprint (or unconditionally when apcIntersects is missing), then squad.removeSoldiers(remaining, reason, x, z) unless squad.invulnerable (gate pass / intro / level end) — reasons: slam→'slam', charge & lane→'charge', stomp→'stomp', car→'car', chew→'chew', spit3/rain→'spit'. kills_total per ARCH §8.7 with C = squad.count at resolve time and L = max(1, ctx.level.level).

Telegraph decals are owned by boss (like zombies own theirs): fx.decal('ring'|'lane'|'xband'|'arc', x, z, size, seconds, colour) with size = full extent (ring diameter = 2·radius, stripe width, band width, splash diameter), fx.decalProgress each step, fx.removeDecal at resolution/cancel/reset. Colours: PALETTE.boss.rage for red telegraphs, PALETTE.fx.acid for arcs. Boss also calls fx.addTrauma(JUICE.trauma.bossSlam) + fx.emit('dust') on slam/stomp/car/charge impacts, fx.emit('spark') on plate detach and shield break, fx.vignette(PALETTE.flash.red, JUICE.flashes.chewVignette) per chew, fx.slowmo + fx.addTrauma(JUICE.trauma.bossDeath) on death; the J15/J16 flashes, haptics, bloom ramp, confetti and coin fountain are left to fx's boss:phase/boss:dead listeners.

Minion bursts: BOSSES.minionBurst.count walkers every `every` s while the pair is in phase 1 only (GDD §7 phase-1 row); spawn actions and bursts call zombies.spawnWave(WAVE, minionHp) with a module-level WAVE { pattern:'horde', units:{all five types, absent = 0}, x: bossX, z: max(spawnZ, bossZ − 6) } and a copied minionHp (never the caller's object; missing minionHp → baseHp with warnOnce).

Safety valve: after BOSSES.valve.after s of fight every unit's hold target becomes valve.z; once the nearest unit is within 1.5 m of it, one chew per second removes valve.perSec soldiers (reason 'chew', after APC absorb) with boss:attack {kind:'chew'} and a red vignette pulse; regular attacks stop during the valve.

Death: when the last twin reaches 0 → _dead, bossActive=false immediately, fx.slowmo(death.slowmo, slowmoTime), boss:dead {id,x,z}, coin:pickup {amount: ECONOMY.bossCoins(L), y: coreY, source:'boss'}, globs/decals cleared. Each unit (a twin dying early too) collapses in real time: falls toward the squad over 65 % of BOSSES.death.collapse then sinks, light fades, rig hidden; the corpse rides the road (z += roadSpeed·dt) while steps still run. A twin dying early is excluded from hitTestSegment/aimPoint/damage/mirror immediately. When every rig is gone render() releases the units and sets _spawned=false (level finishes on its own 3 s deadline).

decisions: applyGate value conventions (contract gives only op + number): '-' uses |value| as the loss, because gates.js stores the red value SIGNED (-15 ... 0 ... +15, js/gates.js:159) and GDD §4.3 writes 'max(1, C - N)' for the gate '-N'; a signed -15 and a magnitude 15 both lose 15. A flipped minus lane is expected to arrive as op '+' (its glyph swaps to '+'). '/' with value > 0 -> ceil(C / value), so a flipped divide ladder (x2) is expected as 'x' 2 (or '/' 0.5, which ceil(C/0.5) = 2C handles exactly); '/' 1 is the neutral x1. 'never below 1' is a final clamp on every op; count capped at SQUAD.countCap.

applyGate always emits exactly ONE squad:count with reason 'gate' (via addSoldiers for gains -> also squad:spawn; via setCount for losses/neutral -> delta may be 0 for x1), never squad:loss; then setInvulnerable(SQUAD.invulnOnPass). It returns a module-level reused { before, after } object (callers copy).

Matrices are composed by squad itself (Ry(yaw) * Rx(pitch) * Rz(roll) * scale, feet at y = 0) straight into instances.mesh.instanceMatrix.array (standard InstancedMesh layout, 16 floats per instance; commit() uploads it) instead of CharacterInstances.writeMatrix, because writeMatrix has no roll parameter and GDD §3.1 asks for a 6° roll into lateral movement. Characters face -Z (models.js header) so yaw 0 = marching; +pitch topples the head toward +Z (away from an attacker in front); roll = -clamp(vx/maxSpeed, -1, 1) * leanDeg, smoothed with steer.smoothRate. Verified numerically in the harness against the real three.js InstancedMesh.

Death: the victim leaves its slot at once, is frozen in WORLD coordinates, faces the attacker (yaw = atan2(-dx, -dz)), topples 0 -> pi/2 with ease.outBack over SQUAD.death.topple, death01 = sinceDeath / (topple + sink) per the models.js shader contract (shader sinks + darkens), drifts toward +Z at ctx.world.roadSpeed (left behind by the marching squad), setSpeed(0) freezes limbs, setHit(uTime) flashes, instance freed at SQUAD.death.free.

Gate losses / vmax drops dissolve rim-inward: displaced records (highest slot indices first) leave their slots immediately, keep marching in formation-local coordinates until their scheduled start (k-th soldier starts at floor(k / SQUAD.dissolvePer100ms) * 0.1 s), then shrink (1 - outQuad) and sink (death01 ramp) over DISSOLVE_SECONDS, then free. No squad:loss events.

Reconciliation model (_settle): the live formation must occupy exactly slots [0, V), V = min(C, params.vmax). Displaced occupants (slots >= V) walk to the nearest vacancy (nearest-slot reassignment); with no vacancy left they dissolve rim-first; remaining vacancies are filled by reserve soldiers stepping up from behind the rear row (deaths while C > vmax, vmax raises). Deaths request a settle after SQUAD.reflowDelay (the hole stays legible); count increases, gate losses and vmax changes settle immediately. The settle is retried next step when the 300-instance pool is momentarily full (ctx.debug.dropped.squad is incremented).

Spawn bursts: every vacant slot below V is filled; the first SQUAD.spawnAnim.maxVisible (40) new soldiers start at the world origin (gate footprint / blob centre, +- one slot spacing of rngFx jitter), hidden until their staggered start (k * 0.04 s), then scale 0 -> 1.15 -> 1 over 0.3 s while lerping to their slot with 1 - exp(-slotLerpRate*dt); the rest appear instantly in place. reset()/'start' pops soldiers in place with the stagger; setCount(n, 'debug'/'medic'...) bursts from the formation centre.

No event subscriptions (ARCH §6.5 lists none): ctx.quality.params.vmax is read every step and a change re-settles the formation within one step; dispose() therefore removes no listeners, only the mesh (geometry/material belong to ModelLibrary and are shared with troop meshes, so they are not disposed).

Animation clock: squad accumulates its own scaled clock _t in step(); render uses _t + alpha * WORLD.step. In 'complete' / 'gameover' (no steps run, ARCH §4.2) render advances a coast offset by ctx.time.dt so topples and dissolves finish; the coast resets in reset().

Steering: target = clamp(input.targetX, +-steerRange); while lane-locked it is clamped to laneX +- SQUAD.steer.laneLockHalfWidth and THEN to +-steerRange again (triple outer lanes at +-2.7 lie beyond 2.1, so the squad holds at the range edge, which is still nearest that lane). squadX = lerpExp(..., smoothRate) with |delta| <= maxSpeed * dt; squad never writes ctx.input.

removeSoldiers returns early while invulnerable (GDD §6.1 'During a gate pass the squad is invulnerable'), in addition to the zombies' own check, so boss attacks landing inside the 0.6 s pass window or after the won-state setInvulnerable(Infinity) cost nothing. Plates absorb 1:1 only for reasons in GEAR.armor.absorbs ('bite', 'spit'); a brute swing is one call with n = 3 -> 3 plates. Each visible death takes nearestSoldierIndex(attacker) (ties -> the outer slot); squad:loss carries the VICTIM's world position (better for fx blood/floaters), falling back to the attacker position when C > Vmax left no visible body.

setInvulnerable(seconds) never shortens an active window (max semantics; Infinity allowed); 0 or a negative value cancels. squad:invuln is emitted only on transitions; ctx.world.invulnerable is mirrored immediately and every step. reset() emits squad:invuln {on:false} / armor:change only when something was active, and squad:count {prev: 0, delta: start, reason: 'start'}.

Shooter slots = the min(V, FIRE.shooters) front-most occupied-formation slots (z ascending, then |x|), rebuilt whenever the formation settles or spawns; shooterPosition(k) = soldier position + FIRE.muzzleOffset, a still-spawning shooter fires from its slot target (so bullets never originate at a gate footprint), k out of range falls back to the front-centre muzzle. setFireVisual(k) -> instances.setFire(inst, ctx.render.uniforms.uTime.value).

Slot table: hex lattice (0.34 spacing, 0.294 row pitch, SQUAD.rowOffset on odd rows, |x| <= 1.8 -> 11/10 columns), sorted by elliptical norm rounded to 1e-6 with ties front-first then nearer the centre line; frontOffset[n] = min z of the first n slots so the front row sits at z = 0; halfWidthAt/depthAt precomputed. Measured: hw <= 1.70 m, depth@40 = 2.35 m, depth@120 = 4.70 m, depth@200 = 6.47 m (the GDD's '5.9 m' was an estimate; the GDD lattice parameters give 6.47).

Low tier blob shadows: render.blobShadowSlot(RENDER.blobShadow.slots.squad + instanceIndex, wx, wz, scale) for every live instance only when ctx.quality.params.shadows === false; instances freed since the last frame are zeroed, and all slots are zeroed once when leaving Low.

Soldier walk speed attribute (iAnim.y) is set to 1 at spawn and 0 at death/dissolve start and never varied, because the models.js shader multiplies uTime by it (a continuous change would jump the phase); per-soldier phase, yaw jitter and tint jitter come from ctx.rngFx. Per-instance statics are re-applied in the onMove callback so squad does not depend on CharacterInstances copying attributes on swap-remove.

gates.js (416 lines, no squad calls yet) must call squad.lockLane(nearestLaneX) at WORLD.gateCommitZ and squad.lockLane(null) after the pass, and squad.applyGate(op, value, gate.x, gate.z) with: '+' value; '-' the signed red value (or its magnitude, both lose |value|); a FLIPPED minus lane as op '+' value; 'x' mult; '/' divisor, and a flipped divide ladder as 'x' 2 (or '/' 0.5). Passing '/' 2 to mean 'x2' would halve the squad. Its `other.wouldBe` must use the same §4.3 math (+N, max(1, C-N), C*M, ceil(C/D), all clamped >= 1).

squad:dead.fraction = clamp(ctx.world.distance / ctx.run.length, 0, 1) (0 when ctx.run is absent); level must create ctx.run with `length` before the first loss.

Pool capacity math: 300 instances cover V <= 200 plus dying (freed at 1.4 s) plus dissolving (freed <= ~1.5 s after a 140-soldier vmax drop). A huge positive gate right after a vmax drop can momentarily exhaust it: squad drops the extra visual spawns, counts ctx.debug.dropped.squad and completes the formation on the next steps (verified in the harness). No gameplay count is ever affected.

Depth of the 200-formation is 6.47 m (GDD §3.1 says ~5.9 m): troops' rear slot (sniper at squad.depth + margin) and the camera framing adapt automatically; if the design wants 5.9 m, lower SQUAD.ellipseZ (e.g. 1.45) in data.js — squad reads it.

'never below 1', stagger, dissolve cadence 12 per 100 ms, bites + reflow at 0.2 s + free at 1.4 s, plates for bite/spit vs slam, invulnerability incl. risks: The flipped-gate value convention is the one real integration hazard: if gates.js passes op '-' with a positive value for a FLIPPED minus lane (instead of '+'), the squad loses soldiers on a blue gate; if it passes '/' 2 for a flipped divide (instead of 'x' 2 or '/' 0.5), the squad is halved. Both are a one-line fix on either side but silent at runtime.

Direct instanceMatrix.array writes assume CharacterInstances keeps the standard InstancedMesh storage and that commit() flags instanceMatrix.needsUpdate unconditionally (per contract). If E4 adds bookkeeping inside writeMatrix (e.g. a per-class y offset or bounding-sphere tracking), squad bypasses it.

GDD numbers make the 40 visible spawns of a big gate stagger over up to 1.6 s (40 x 0.04 s), so the last soldiers of a +100 gate arrive noticeably late; shooters still fire from their slot targets meanwhile. Tune SQUAD.spawnAnim.stagger if it reads slow.

Reserve soldiers (C > Vmax deaths, Vmax raises) spawn behind the rear row and lerp through the blob to their slot, overlapping neighbours for ~0.3 s; acceptable at the camera distance but visible on Low when a tier raise brings 140 soldiers in at once.

All squad animations run on the scaled clock, so under the 0.25 boss-death / game-over slow-mo topples and dissolves stretch 4x (intended theatre); in complete/gameover they coast on ctx.time.dt, which assumes engine keeps time.dt valid there (it does per engine.js beginFrame).
Yaw/roll/pitch sign conventions were derived from models.js's stated -Z facing and verified only mathematically (head position after topple); a visual pass may flip the lean sign.

The formation depth (6.47 m at 200) is larger than the GDD's 5.9 m estimate; big squads reach ~6.5 m toward the camera, which the camera presets (look-at z -14/-16) accommodate but which slightly enlarges the slam/spit 'formation centre' geometry relative to the design's assumption.

decisions: Ids: id = (generation << 12) | slot with per-type slot ranges from ZOMBIES[type].slotBase; generation wraps at 19 bits so ids stay positive 31-bit ints. Validation: damage/hpOf/setBurning/isBurning accept only ALIVE ids; typeOf/position also answer for DYING bodies ('' / unchanged out for free or stale). alive/dying/free states exactly per §6.7: dying bodies are in no bin, no query, no counter, no contact; they topple (ease.outBack to π/2 over death.topple) then setDeath(sink01) drives the shader sink, slot freed at death.free (or earlier if carried past despawnZ).
Contract's `get aliveOfType(type)` is implemented as a method `aliveOfType(type)` (a getter cannot take an argument). Extra public method `isBurning(id)` added for testers.

Burn bonus: zombies.damage() multiplies cause 'bullet' damage by (1 + TROOPS.flamer.burnBonus) while burning, per §6.7 setBurning. damageInCone does NOT auto-tag burning (troops.js tags via forEachAlive + setBurning, matching the existing troops.js scan), so no double-tag; damageInCircle has no type filter (troops.js already filters crawlers itself before damage(..., 'crush')).

damageInCone halfAngle: interpreted as DEGREES when > π (the contract passes coneDeg/2 = 12.5), accepted as radians otherwise — no silent miss either way. Direction is normalised; a zombie standing on the nozzle always counts; angular allowance = half + asin(radius/d).

Crawler hittableZ rule applied in hitTestSegment and damageInLine only (bullet height); AOE (damageInCircle / damageInCone), highestHp and nearest ignore it (explosions, fire, crush and the sniper reach crawlers).

Contact rules: APC test (troops.apcIntersects) first, then squad.intersectsCircle with !squad.invulnerable; regular zombies bite then die (cause 'bite', no coins, zombie:bite only when kills > 0 — a spitter dies silently with bite 0); brutes hold at the front row (total vz = 0, walking in place against the road scroll), swing removeSoldiers(3,'bite') once per swing.cooldown, only after the ring telegraph filled; a staggered brute still holds (never carried into the formation) but cannot swing. An invulnerable squad is walked through without biting (the zombie later despawns as 'cleanup').

Brute telegraph: at z ≥ swing.ringZ → fx.decal('ring', x, z, 2·ringR, Infinity, PALETTE.flash.red) following the brute via moveDecal, decalProgress fills over swing.telegraph, then re-fills between swings as a swing gauge (1 − cooldownLeft/cooldown); zombie:telegraph {kind:'ring', radius 3, duration 0.8} emitted once (audio roar). 'charge' telegraph at z ≥ −charge.dist. Decal removed on death/free/reset. Decal size convention assumed = diameter (consistent with gates' lane decal size 4 = lane width); fx.decal failure (non-number / negative) tolerated.

Spitter: holds at hold.z for hold.max s (total vz 0) then advances; spits every spit.every from z ≥ hold.z (first after SPIT_FIRST_DELAY) at the formation centre (squad.centerZ) with x led by a smoothed squad lateral-velocity estimate × flight time, clamped to ±WORLD.steerRange; glob flight T = dist/spit.speed on a parabola (apex SPIT_ARC_HEIGHT); 'arc' decal + zombie:telegraph {kind:'spit', id = spitter, radius splash, duration ≤ preview} shown spit.preview s before impact with decalProgress; impact → troops.apcAbsorb(k) if the APC covers it, else formation-centre test |squad.x−x| < splash && |squad.centerZ−z| < splash and !invulnerable → removeSoldiers(k,'spit'); spit:impact {x,z,radius,kills=actual}. kills = spit.kills, +1 from kills2FromLevel (ctx.level.level read at launch).

Wave layouts (GDD §6.2): line = even across ±line.xRange (±GUARD_LINE_HALF around wave.x when x is given, i.e. guards), z jitter by spread; column = single file at wave.x, column.gap apart toward −Z; horde = uniform in horde.box (depth = spread when given); flank = alternating clusters at ±flank.x; pincer = runners alternate the two road edges, others in the centre; wall = brute line in front, crawler carpet carpetGap behind, other types in a line between. Unit order is shuffled with ctx.rng for line/column/horde/flank (deterministic per seed); every x is clamped to roadWidth/2 − radius. opts.lunge makes a crawler lunge from spawn. Pool-full spawns return −1 and bump ctx.debug.dropped['zombies.<type>'].

AI per GDD §6.1: walker drift homeX + amp·sin(freq·t + φ); runner re-targets squad x every zigzag.retarget, centre lerps at RUNNER_LATERAL_RATE, zig-zag amp/period, screech telegraph once at z ≥ screechZ with a forward lean (negative pitchTopple); crawler lunges at lunge.speed from −lunge.dist with 'lunge' telegraph and a dust trail; brute charges from −charge.dist with lateral homing, staggers (0.3 s freeze: setSpeed 0, carried by the road, recoil pitch, zombie:stagger) each staggerEvery of max HP crossed. Facing: yawToward(vx, max(own forward speed, def.speed)) smoothed — never flips while holding against the road.

Rendering: one writeMatrix per live instance per frame with alpha extrapolation (z + vz·alpha·STEP; dying bodies by roadSpeed), commit() once per pool; HP bars = one InstancedMesh(PlaneGeometry(hpBar.w, hpBar.h), render.materials.hpBar(), 260) with a FLOAT `iHp` attribute (matches render.js HPBAR_VERT `attribute float iHp`), matrix = translation + scale(radius/walkerRadius, 1) at height + hpBar.above; policy: 'never' hidden, 'always' shown on params.hpBars 'all', 'afterHit' after the first hit, Low ('damaged') only when hp < maxHp. Globs = InstancedMesh(models.geo.glob ?? IcosahedronGeometry(globRadius, 0), own emissive acid MeshStandardMaterial, 32). Attribute commits re-push a persistent {start,count} into attr.updateRanges (three's addUpdateRange would allocate per call) — measured steady-state heap delta ≤ 0 over 1200 busy steps.

Low tier blob shadows: render.blobShadowSlot(300 + slot, x, z, radius/RENDER.blobShadow.radius) only when !params.shadows AND the method exists (flag cached at init and on quality:change; render.js does not expose it yet); freed slots and reset() write scale 0 so no stale discs remain. quality:change → mesh.castShadow = params.shadows && ZOMBIES[type].shadow (crawlers never).

Behind-the-camera recycling (z > despawnZ) emits zombie:die {cause:'cleanup'} then frees immediately (no animation); killAll(cause) kills every alive zombie with the normal topple (coins only for causes ≠ bite/cleanup). reset() is idempotent and allocation-free (frees instances from the top down, refills free stacks, removes decals, zeroes blob slots, clears globs/bins/timers). dispose() unsubscribes quality:change, scene.remove()s every mesh, disposes the hp-bar geometry, the glob material (and glob geometry only when self-owned), and calls inst.dispose?.().
